newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Gines Navarro, OCP plan to merge.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Gines Navarro, OCP plan to merge.

text.p: Spanish construction firms Gines Navarro and OCP Construcciones said on Monday they planned to merge.
"The board of directors at Gines Navarro and OCP have adopted an agreement to initiate studies on the elaboration of the merger project of the two companies," the two firms said in a statement.
The chairmen of the two firms will now begin to negotiate the terms of the merger, the statement said.
Spain's stock market watchdog, the CNMV, earlier suspended shares in Gines Navarro and OCP citing special factors which could affect the two companies.
